raw_text:
Second review of run r-20261006T164125231495-jtmm-probe-angle-guards (plan imas-ambix:jt60sa-machine-map section 6), read at its single head 10c477bdd874b968079acf5b59dc16db4d38f1e0 on base 7b434afd85a0f6b273a3e61f6e84353c5c25c02d. The node repairs the two follow-ons the review of jtmm-probe-angle-engine recorded against _supply_emitted_probe_angles: it bound emitted poloidal_angle values to mapped probes by array position, and it read every target_unit other than the literal rad as degrees. This reviewer extracted the committed tree to a node-local scratch (git archive 10c477bd), ran the node's own gate there in the shared project environment, and falsified each new guard by mutation. Nothing ran on a GPU node.

VERDICT goal: both follow-ons are repaired by measurement. The reader now reads the emitted magnetics/b_field_pol_probe/name array and joins each angle to its mapped probe by that name, which is the mapped probe's amb_channel (description_reader.py:134-179), and it refuses an angle whose probe is unmapped (:176-179) and a mapped probe with no emitted angle (:167-172); the unit is chosen from a two-entry converter table, rad converted and deg carried, with every other spelling refused rather than read as degrees (:125-131). The identity key is well founded: both the emitted name and the mapped amb_channel derive from the same DD magnetics/b_field_pol_probe/name leaf (selene_deck.build_magnetics:914-915 writes out.name, geometry_adapter._names:152-163 reads it, and _b_probes:194 sets amb_channel from names[item]), so the join is not an assumption about two independently authored fields.
VERDICT done_when: the dispatched measure is this record; it is stored parsed at the fenced path with six dimensions scored in 0..20, the reviewed base and head shas, and added_failure_count / added_failure_ids.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed commit touches exactly its four declared paths -- imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py, tests/data/test_description_reader.py, tests/data/test_* (tests/data/test_selene_deck.py) and the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-probe-angle-guards.html -- and nothing else (git diff --name-status 7b434afd..10c477bd lists those four). This reviewer wrote only the fenced record paths.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, single commit 10c477bd, the tests line naming the two-file gate at 44 passed, test_logs naming gate.log and negative_control.log, and a negative_control_note declaring a positional-join mutation. Its byte-identity claim for the four repointed deck files reproduces here (sha256 equal for EQSLE.DATA, geo.in, coil_vv_OP1.dat, coil_vv_OP2.dat against the reckon copies the test read before).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit; the single commit 10c477bd (+154/-44 over four files) adds _PROBE_NAME_DD_PATH and _ANGLE_UNIT_CONVERTERS, rewrites _supply_emitted_probe_angles to refuse an unknown unit, to require exactly one name array, to refuse duplicate names, and to join by identity with both directional refusals; the tests add a refused-unit case, a permuted-array identity case and both mismatch directions, and test_selene_deck's four real-deck constants are repointed to JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR/source.
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: position never places an angle (the join is by name, description_reader.py:165-173) and a non-rad, non-deg unit is refused (description_reader.py:125-131); both directions of the repair are asserted and this reviewer reproduced the node's own permuted-array case at 10c477bd (test_description_source_joins_a_permuted_angle_array_by_probe_identity PASSED).
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the node's gate reproduces independently in a scratch extraction of 10c477bd under the shared environment -- 44 passed, EXIT=0 (gate-head.log) -- and its declared negative control reproduces: replacing the identity lookup with positional assignment gives 1 failed, EXIT=1, p1=80.0 against expected 10.0, matching negative_control.log. Docked one for the reviewed run's gate.log header naming the base revision 7b434afd rather than the committed head, so a reader correlating header to commit sees a mismatch.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 7b434afd..10c477bd lists only the declared source, its two test files and the evidence fragment; no concurrent node's path and no figure directory. The change also retires nothing and adds no public definition, matching the node's declared scope.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: every behaviour the repair introduces carries a test with teeth -- the unit refusal (M2 reddens test_description_source_refuses_an_unknown_angle_unit, 1 failed), the unmapped-probe refusal (M3 reddens test_description_source_refuses_an_angle_for_an_unmapped_probe), the missing-angle refusal (M4 reddens test_description_source_refuses_a_probe_the_angles_do_not_cover), and the identity join (M1 reddens the permuted case) -- against a head of 44 passed. Three refusal branches added by the change are untested: the exactly-one name array requirement (description_reader.py:139-143), the duplicate-name refusal (:155-159) and the names-vs-angles count check (:148-151); the description route also has no live consumer until a JT-60SA poloidal_angle binding exists.
SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change implements the two follow-ons within section 6's one-selector rule (it extends the existing probe_angle_source description supplier rather than adding a branch elsewhere), reuses the module's DescriptionReadError and dataclasses.replace idiom, and ruff check imas_ambix tests exits 0; the naming scans are clean over the added lines, the commit carries a conventional subject and a body, and neither the commit, symbols nor comments carry a plan, sprint, ticket or attribution string.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: no capability is forked -- the reader adds a module-level converter table reusing np.rad2deg, keeps the single _probe_angle_description test helper extended with a names parameter rather than a second helper, and reuses the store constant JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR instead of a hard-coded path; no new public surface is introduced.
